children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) is poised to break a resistance at $7.28 per bushel and rise into the $7.33-3/4 to $7.37-1/2 range.
The contract has stabilized around a support at $7.12-3/4 twice. This stabilization suggests a double-bottom formation, which will be confirmed when the market breaks $7.33-3/4.
Immediate support is at $7.23-1/4, a break below which could trigger a fall into the $7.12-3/4 to $7.18-1/2 range.
